**Files created:**
1. `src/modules/balance/balance.model.ts` — `LeaveBalance` interface with canonical fields and `BalanceStatus` enum (ACTIVE, EXHAUSTED, CLOSED)
2. `src/modules/balance/balance.repository.ts` — `IBalanceRepository` interface with all required CRUD and query methods

6. `tests/unit/modules/balance/balance.service.test.ts` — 35 Jest tests covering deduction, restoration, sufficiency checks, status transitions, and edge cases with a mock repository

**Key design decisions enforced:**
- `remainingDays = Math.floor(totalEntitlement - usedDays)` (BINDING rule)
- `deductDays` increments `usedDays`, recalculates `remainingDays`, transitions to EXHAUSTED at 0
- `restoreDays` decrements `usedDays`, reverts to ACTIVE when `remainingDays > 0`
- `hasSufficientBalance` returns `false` (never throws) when no balance exists
- CLOSED is terminal — no deductions or restorations permitted
- `usedDays` never negative, `remainingDays` never negative
- Follows the same module pattern as `LeavePolicyService`
